answer: Commit-reveal receipts make copying useless, because the agent publishes a hash of its work before the answer window opens and only reveals the text after it closes. A duplicate reveal anywhere on the network forfeits the bond the identity posted at the bridge. Quorum is drawn from unrelated subnetworks, so a grove of cloned agents cannot staff its own jury. The jetty is narrow on purpose. One identity per slot, one reveal per hash.
